data.contenido:
Ombimbeli itayi gandja owala ehokololo lyoshili lyaashoka sha ningwa nale, ihe otayi hokolola wo shoka tashi ka ningwa monakuyiwa. Aantu itaa vulu okuhunganeka onakuyiwa. Shika osho molwashoka tu shi kutya Ombimbeli oya za kuKalunga. Ombimbeli otayi ti ngiini kombinga yonakuyiwa?

Otayi hokolola kombinga yiita iinene yaKalunga. Kalunga ota ka opaleka evi kuuwinayi auhe nokaantu aawinayi niita mbika, ihe ye ota ka gamena mboka haye mu longele. Omukwaniilwa gwaKalunga, Jesus Kristus, ota ka sa oshimpwiyu opo aapiya yaKalunga ya nyanyukilwe ombili nelago, nonokutya yo itaye ke ehama we nando nenge ya se.

Tse otatu vulu okukala twa nyanyukwa molwashoka Kalunga ota ka ninga oparadisa ompe kombanda yevi, hasho mbela? Ihe tse otu na okuninga po sha ngele tse otwa hala okukala moparadisa ndjika. Ehokololo lyahugunina membo otali tu longo shoka tse tu na okuninga opo tu nyanyukilwe iinima iikumithi mbyoka Kalunga a pungulila mboka haye mu longele. Ano lesha OSHITOPOLWA 8 nokumona shoka Ombimbeli tayi hunganekele onakuyiwa.

OSHIKE u wete mpaka? Eeno, etanga lyaakwiita ya londa kuukambe uutokele. Ihe tala mpoka yo taa zi. Uukambe otau matuka miikogo tau zi megulu! Mbela omu na ngaa shili uukambe megulu?

Aawe, kau shi uukambe wo wene. Tse otu shi shi, oshoka uukambe itau vulu okumatuka miikogo, hasho mbela? Ihe Ombimbeli otayi popi kombinga yuukambe womegulu. Owa tseya kutya omolwashike?

Osho molwashoka nale uukambe owa longithwa olwindji pethimbo lyiita. Ano Ombimbeli otayi hokolola kombinga yaantu mboka ya londa kuukambe okuza megulu okuulika kutya Kalunga ota ka hingila aantu yokombanda yevi iita. Owa tseya kutya ehala lyolugodhi nduka ohali ithanwa ngiini? OHarmagedon. Iita mbyoka otayi ka hanagula po uuwinayi auhe kombanda yevi.

Jesus oye Ngoka ta ka kwatela komeho molugodhi lwiita mbika puHarmagedon. Dhimbulukwa kutya Jesus oye ngoka a hogololwa kuJehova okukala omukwaniilwa gwepangelo Lye. Osho molwashoka ye a zala oshishani. Negongamwele otali ulike kutya ye ota ka dhipaga po aatondi yaKalunga ayehe. Mbela tse otu na okukala twa kumwa molwashoka Kalunga ota ka hanagula po aantu ayehe aawinayi?

Tala konima kEhokololo 10. Ou wete shike mpoka? Eeno, Eyelu enene ndyoka tali hanagula po aantu aawinayi. Olye e eta Eyelu ndyoka? OJehova Kalunga. Tala ngashingeyi kEhokololo 15. Oshike tashi ningwa mpoka? Sodom naGomorra otayi hanagulwa po komulilo ngoka Jehova a tumu.

Yanuna kEhokololo 33. Tala shoka tashi ningilwa uukambe nomatembalugodhi gAaegipiti. Olye e ya kungulukithile omeya? OJehova. Ye okwe shi ningi okugamena oshigwana she. Tala kEhokololo 76. Ngoye oto ka mona mpoka kutya Jehova ota hanagulitha po nokuli oshigwana she Aaisrael molwuuwinayi washo.

Ano kashi na oku tu kumitha ngele Jehova ta ka tuma omatanga ge gaakwiita yomegulu okuhulitha po uuwinayi auhe kombanda yevi. Ihe dhiladhila owala shoka tashi ka tya! Yanuna ko e to tala. Ehololo 16:16; 19:11-16.

TALA komiti ndhoka ominene, oongala oombwanawa noondundu oondeendeka. Mpaka opuuwanawa ndishi? Tala nkene okapundja taka li moshikaha shomumati. Nou tale koonkoshi nuukambe wa thikama hwiya konima yadho. Ngoye ito ka hala ando mbela okukala megumbo li li mehala lya fa ndika?

Kalunga okwa hala ngoye u kale nomwenyo sigo aluhe moparadisa kombanda yevi. Nokwa hala ngoye waa hepekwe komikithi nokuuwehame mbyoka aantu ye na nena. Kwaamboka taa ka kala moparadisa ompe, Ombimbeli otayi uvaneke: ‘Kalunga ota ka kala pamwe nayo. Itamu ka kala we eso nenge okulila nenge uuwehame. Iinima iikulu oya hulu po.’ Jesus ota ka sa oshimpwiyu opo elunduluko ndika ekumithi li ningwe. Owa tseya kutya uunake? Eeno, okonima ngele ye o opaleke evi kuuwinayi auhe naantu aawinayi. Dhimbulukwa kutya Jesus okwa aludhile aantu komikithi dhi ili nodhi ili sho ye a li kombanda yevi, nonokuli ye okwa yumudhile aasi. Jesus okwe shi ningi okuulika shoka ye ta ka ninga kombanda yevi alihe uuna ye a ningi Omukwaniilwa gwUukwaniilwa waKalunga.

Dhiladhila owala nkene tashi ka kala oshikumithi moparadisa ompe kombanda yevi! Jesus ota ka pangela okuza megulu pamwe naamboka ye ta hogolola. Aapangeli mbaka otaa ka tonatela ayehe kombanda yevi notaa ka sa oshimpwiyu opo yo ya kale nelago. Natu tale shoka tse tu na okuninga opo tu kale nuushili kutya Kalunga ote ke tu pa omwenyo gwaaluhe moparadisa ye ompe. Ehololo 21:3, 4; 5:9, 10, faatha-nitha oNew World Translation of the Holy Scriptures; 14:1-3.

data.titulo: Nkene Tse Tatu Vulu Okukala nOmwenyo sigo Aluhe
data.contenido:
OU WETE shoka omukadhona nookuume ke mbaka taa lesha? Eeno, olyo embo ndika ndyoka ngoye to lesha ngashingeyi—Embo Lyandje lyOmahokololo gOmbimbeli. Notaa lesha ehokololo lya faathana naandyoka ngoye to lesha ngashingeyi—“Nkene Tatu Vulu Okukala nOmwenyo sigo Aluhe.”

Owa tseya mbela kutya yo otayi ilongo shike? Shotango, osho kutya tse otu na okutseya Jehova nOmwana gwe Jesus ngele otwa hala okukala nomwenyo sigo aluhe. Ombimbeli otayi ti: ‘Komukalo ngoka omuntu ota vulu okukala nomwenyo sigo aluhe: Ilonga kombinga yaKalunga awike kashili, nOmwana ngoka ye a tuma kombanda yevi, Jesus Kristus.’

Ongiini tse tatu vulu okwiilonga kombinga yaJehova Kalunga nOmwana gwe Jesus? Omukalo gumwe ogwo okulesha Embo Lyandje lyOmahokololo gOmbimbeli okuza ketameko sigo okehulilo. Otali hokolola oshindji kombinga yaJehova naJesus, hasho mbela? Notali hokolola oshindji kombinga yiinima mbyoka yo ya ningi nale naambyoka yo taa ka ninga natango. Ihe tse otu na okuninga oshindji shi vulithe okulesha owala embo ndika.

Ou wete embo lilwe polupanda? Olyo Ombimbeli. Gumwe ne ku leshele iitopolwa mOmbimbeli hoka omahokololo membo ndika ga kankamena. Ombimbeli otayi tu pe omayelithilo agehe ngoka tse twa pumbwa opo tu longele Jehova komukalo gu uka nokumona omwenyo gwaaluhe. Ano tse otu na oku shi ninga omukalondjigilile okukonakona Ombimbeli aluhe.

Ihe inashi gwana okwiilonga owala kombinga yaJehova Kalunga naJesus Kristus. Tse otatu vulu okukala tu na ontseyo oyindji noonkondo kombinga yawo nokombinga yomalongo gawo, ihe nonatango itatu mono omwenyo gwaaluhe. Owa tseya mbela kutya oshike sha pumbiwa natango?

Tse otu na wo okukala painima mbyoka twi ilonga. Oto dhimbulukwa mbela Judas Iskariot? Ye okwa li gumwe gwomwaamboka 12 mboka Jesus a hogolola oyo aayapostoli ye. Judas okwa li e na ontseyo oyindji kombinga yaJehova naJesus. Ihe oshike she mu ningilwa? Konima yokathimbo ye okwa ningi omwiiholimwene nokwa gwaaleke Jesus molwiisiliveli 30 oku mu gandja kaatondi ye. Ano Judas ita ka mona omwenyo gwaaluhe.

Oto dhimbulukwa mbela Gehasi, omulumentu ngoka tse twi ilongo mEhokololo 69? Ye okwa halele oonguwo niimaliwa mbyoka kaayi shi ye. Ano ye okwa hokolola iifundja opo a mone iinima mbika. Ihe Jehova okwe mu geyele. Note ke tu geyela wo ngele tse itatu vulika koompango dhe.

Ihe opu na aantu oyendji aawanawa mboka ya li ya longele Jehova aluhe nuudhiginini. Tse otwa hala okukala twe ya fa, hasho mbela? Omugundjuka Samuel oye oshiholelwa oshiwanawa okulandulwa. Dhimbulukwa, ngaashi twe shi mono mEhokololo 55, ye okwa li owala e na oomvula ne nenge ntano sho ye a tameke okulongela Jehova metsalihangano lye. Ano nonando ngoye ou kale omushona shi thike peni, ku shi omushona unene nokulongela Jehova.

Dhoshili, Jesus Kristus oye omuntu ngoka tse atuhe twa hala okulandula. Nokuli sho ye a li okamati, ye okwa li hwiyaka motempeli ta popi nayalwe kombinga yaHe gwomegulu, ngaashi Ehokololo 87 tali ulike. Natu landule oshiholelwa she. Natu hokololele aantu oyendji ngaashi tashi vulika kombinga yaJehova Kalunga ketu omukumithi nOmwana gwe, Jesus Kristus. Ngele tse otatu ningi iinima mbika, tse otatu vulu oku ka kala nomwenyo sigo aluhe moparadisa ompe yaKalunga kombanda yevi. Johannes 17:3; Epsalmi 145:1-21.
